assessments.name: Final exam
assessments.description: A written exam testing the application of knowledge acquired throughout the semester. Questions based on lectures, workshops and prac classes through the entire semester.

assessments.name: Weekly quiz
assessments.description: Multiple choice quiz on Canvas during each scheduled weekly workshop or practical class.

assessments.name: Oral presentation: nanoparticles in modern therapeutics
assessments.description: Students will work in groups of 4 to research a therapeutic use of nanoparticles for 1 hour and then deliver a 3-minute presentation, followed by 2 minutes of response to questions on their research.

assessments.name: Practical skills exam
assessments.description: A series of laboratory and data analysis tasks will be performed by every student. Tests will be based on skills and knowledge acquired during the practical classes.
